faq.q: Does UFI supply hospital furniture for government tenders in Nepal?
faq.a: Yes. UFI supplies hospital and institutional furniture for both private healthcare facilities and government tender orders across Nepal, with volume pricing available for bulk ward fit-outs.

faq.q: Are UFI hospital beds rust- and corrosion-resistant?
faq.a: Every UFI hospital bed and trolley goes through the same 9-stage pre-treatment and powder coating process used across all product categories, giving the steel frame long-term resistance to rust and corrosion in high-hygiene, frequently-cleaned environments.

faq.q: What finish options are available for hospital furniture?
faq.a: Hospital furniture is available in clinical white or stainless steel finishes as standard, with manual crank or electric adjustable mechanisms depending on the product.

faq.q: How long does delivery take for hospital furniture orders in Nepal?
faq.a: Delivery timelines depend on order volume and customization. Contact UFI directly with your ward or facility requirements for a specific delivery estimate.

faq.q: Does UFI supply office furniture for corporate bulk orders in Nepal?
faq.a: Yes. UFI supplies desks, seating and storage for corporate offices and co-working spaces across Nepal, with volume pricing for full-office and multi-branch fit-outs.

faq.q: What warranty is offered on UFI office chairs and desks?
faq.a: Office furniture is built on the same powder-coated steel frame construction used across every UFI category. Contact UFI directly for specific warranty terms on individual products.

faq.q: Can office desks be customized to specific workspace dimensions?
faq.a: Yes. Standard desk sizes are available alongside custom sizing for fitted workstations, reception counters, and non-standard office layouts.

faq.q: Do you deliver and install office furniture across Nepal?
faq.a: UFI delivers from its Chitwan manufacturing facility to offices across Nepal. Contact the sales team with your location and order size for a delivery estimate.

faq.q: Are UFI metal sofas comfortable for daily home use?

faq.q: What's the difference between UFI's metal furniture and standard wooden furniture?

manufacturing.nine_step_process._note: Simplified marketing framing, matches the real tank-line photo where content overlaps (Degreasing, Phosphating). See decisions-log.md — the real facility has more granular sub-stages than this 9-step version; this is the current agreed content, not the maximum-detail version.

steps.label: Degreasing
steps.desc: Removes oil, grease and dirt from the raw metal surface.

steps.label: Water Rinse 1
steps.desc: Rinses off the cleaning agent before the next stage.

steps.label: Derusting / Pickling
steps.desc: Removes rust and scale to expose clean, bare metal.

steps.label: Water Rinse 2
steps.desc: Rinses off residual acid from the pickling stage.

steps.label: Neutralizing
steps.desc: Neutralizes any remaining acid reaction on the surface.

steps.label: Water Rinse 3
steps.desc: Rinses off neutralizing residues before phosphating.

steps.label: Phosphating
steps.desc: Creates a protective phosphate layer so the coating bonds permanently.

steps.label: Water Rinse 4
steps.desc: A final rinse with clean water before passivation.

steps.label: Passivation
steps.desc: Enhances corrosion resistance ahead of the powder coating booth.

pages.about.vision: To be the manufacturer Nepal's institutions call first — where a school, a hospital, or a store can order once and trust it for decades.
pages.about.mission: We manufacture precision metal furniture from a single facility in Chitwan — engineering every store rack, school bench, hospital bed and office desk to the same 9-step durability standard, so the institutions and businesses that depend on us never have to think about their furniture again.

paragraphs: Every piece that leaves our Chitwan facility goes through the same 9-stage pre-treatment and powder coating process, regardless of whether it's headed to a hospital ward or a departmental store. Degreasing, derusting, phosphating and passivation aren't steps we skip for a smaller order.
That consistency is the whole point. A steel frame that resists corrosion in a coastal warehouse resists it in Chitwan's monsoon too — the process doesn't change by category or by client size.

whyChitwan.body: While much of the furniture sold in Nepal is imported, every piece UFI makes is manufactured right here in Chitwan. That means shorter lead times, direct communication with the people actually building your order, and furniture designed around how Nepali institutions actually use it — not adapted from a catalog built for somewhere else.

items: The same 9-step powder coating process for a hospital bed and a home dining table — durability isn't rationed by category.
One facility we know well, rather than white-labeling from multiple unverified sources.

directorNote.title: Director & Founder
directorNote._note: Draft quote in his voice, pending his real confirmation before publishing — flagged separately from the approved Vision/Mission content.
directorNote.quote: When we started in 1990, we were a small workshop with a handful of machines and a simple promise — build it once, build it right. Thirty-plus years later, that promise hasn't changed, even as everything else has. Every rack, bench, bed and desk that leaves our facility in Chitwan still carries that same standard. I'm proud of what our team has built — not just the furniture, but the trust that comes with a customer knowing exactly what they're getting, every time.
